text: {"lessons":["Staying invested without reacting to each monthly move has served me reasonably well so far; I should avoid trading just to feel active.","Selling some shares of Stock A and Stock E at gains realized profits, but a gain alone does not tell me whether selling was the right long-term choice.","My account has had both gains and small declines, so I should keep risk and living needs in view and make measured changes rather than chase recent performance."]}
